full_name: IAA Conference on AI for Space (also titled 'IAA Conference on AI in and for Space'; 1st edition held jointly with ESA's SPAICE conference)
organizer: International Academy of Astronautics (IAA). 2024: joint with ESA (SPAICE, ESA Advanced Concepts Team) at ECSAT. 2025: IAA in collaboration with ESA SPAICE series (IAA-SPAICE 2025), Suzhou. 2026 (3rd, Jeju): Organized by IAA; hosted and locally organized by Jeju National University; site footer also shows logos linking to Jeju Special Self-Governing Province, KAIST Space Institute (ksi.kaist.ac.kr), Jeju Tourism Organization and Mobilint (exact co-organizer vs supporter role per logo not separable from page text). Organizing Committee chairs: Nam Seo Goo (Konkuk Univ.), Jae-Hung Han (KAIST), Hyojung Ahn (Jeju National Univ.). General Chair: Olivier Contant (IAA Executive Director).

submission.type: short paper (up to 4 pages excl. references) -> single-round double-blind review -> oral/poster; accepted oral papers submit revised manuscript for proceedings
submission.typical_abstract_deadline: May-August (2024: 27 May; 2025: 20 Aug; 2026: 15 Jun - all after extensions)
submission.notes: 2026 deadlines differ between sources: iaaspace.org event page says abstract 'May 01, 2026 extended to May 25, 2026', final paper Aug 2, 2026; the official site iaa-aispace.org shows abstract May 01 (also shown as May 10) -> June 15, 2026, notification June 1 -> June 30, final paper Aug 2 -> Aug 9, 2026. 2024: special issues in Acta Astronautica and Springer Astrodynamics.

editions.venue: ESA European Centre for Space Applications and Telecommunications (ECSAT)
editions.edition: 1st (joint ESA SPAICE / IAA Conference on AI in and for Space)
editions.notes: Key-dates page shows paper deadline 19 May 2024 replaced by 27 May 2024 (extended): https://spaice.esa.int/2024/key-dates/. Cross-checked 2026-10-16: city wording differs from independent pass ("Harwell (Oxfordshire)") but is the same place (ESA ECSAT, Harwell Campus); no change.
Deadline from https://spaice.esa.int/2025/ which shows '15. July 20. Aug 2025' (15 Jul original, 20 Aug apparent extension). Venue not stated.

Abstract deadline is the latest extension on the official site; iaaspace.org says extended to 2026-05-25. Event page: https://iaaspace.org/event/3rd-iaa-conference-on-ai-for-space/ (its address field wrongly says Montreal). Held alongside the 2026 Jeju Global Future Aerospace Confesta (Aug 27-28) at the same venue.

notes: User-requested top-priority series. Official name on its site: '3rd IAA Conference on AI for Space' (header also says '3rd IAA Conference on AI in and for Space'; short name IAA SpaceAI). No 4th edition announced on iaaspace.org or iaa-aispace.org as of 2026-10-16 (annual cadence suggests 2027 but unverified). Korean involvement verified: Jeju National University is host/local organizer; KAIST and Konkuk Univ. professors chair the OC; KARI, KASI, KAI and ETRI researchers sit on the Scientific Committee. KARI/KASA/KSAS are NOT listed as organizers. A separate sample site (jejuai.bo9jeong.co.kr, titled '(sample) Jeju National Univ. AI international conference') mirrors the content; iaa-aispace.org is treated as official. iaa-aispace.org returns 403 to some fetchers; content was retrieved with a browser user-agent.

verification.crosscheck: independent blind re-research of 2022+ editions, conflicts adjudicated 2026-10-16
